title: Consultant Physician
bio: Dr Olaosebikan provides specialist care for pain, arthritis, autoimmune and rheumatology conditions in Lagos.

His clinical focus includes joint pain, inflammatory arthritis, gout, lupus, autoimmune symptoms, musculoskeletal concerns, inflammatory back pain, and long-term follow-up for chronic rheumatic disease.
Care is built around careful clinical assessment, clear diagnosis, practical treatment planning, symptom control, patient education, and structured follow-up.
professionalMemberships: Rheumatology and internal medicine professional networks
